messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant, or are planning to become pregnant. Rosuvastatin may harm your unborn baby. If you become pregnant while taking rosuvastatin, call your doctor right away to discuss your treatment.
Tell your doctor if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. Medicines like rosuvastatin can pass into your breast milk and may harm your baby. Talk to your doctor about the best way to feed your baby if you take this medicine. Do not breastfeed while taking rosuvastatin.
Triplet: ["Rosuvastatin", "requires patient consultation", "best way to feed baby if taking"]

The relation 'requires patient consultation' in the triplet is defined as 'A patient taking the subject drug should consult a doctor to determine the best course of action in a specified scenario.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires patient to read': The patient is required to review the specified educational materials or documentation related to the medication.
E. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
